captions.detailed: This 3D model features a panoramic sunroof cassette, consisting of a large, flat, rectangular outer frame in a matte light-grey finish. Inside the frame, there is a dark translucent glass panel and an integrated, full-width interior fabric sunshade. The glass panel and the sunshade are designed to slide independently along parallel tracks inside the side rails of the frame, providing realistic sliding motion.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a panoramic sunroof cassette with a light-grey outer frame, a dark glass panel, and a sliding sunshade. The assembly should feature prismatic joints allowing both the glass panel and the sunshade to slide independently along the longitudinal axis.
captions.factory: Construct a base frame using box primitives, filleting the outer corners to form a clean perimeter. Create the glass panel and the sunshade as separate thin box-like parts. Define prismatic articulations (joints) along the longitudinal Y-axis, connecting the glass panel and the sunshade to the main frame, and assign appropriate grey, dark glass, and fabric materials to each part.
